modelRouting.routingRationale: Portable metadata, the complete native host ownership/lifecycle surface, and mechanical adapters have disjoint files and run concurrently; convergence tests consume every foundation output.

objective: Implement M2 repository-local product work from accepted M1 using maximum safe disjoint-lane parallelism, then run pinned external qualification without fabricating unavailable evidence.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of primary checkout HEAD, index, validation, commit, and push; may not edit lane-owned files

interfaceLock.portablePackage: Three repository templates produce a declarative Agent Plugins 1.0 clean-room package. legion_host::agent_plugins generates the verified release binding, identity, and MCP schema into external staging. References close inside the staged package, which uses bare legion serve --stdio --plugin-root ${PLUGIN_ROOT} and contains no executable or source launcher.
interfaceLock.host: legion_host owns containment, release-bound projection, client detection and fidelity, command-resolution evidence, transactional ownership-safe lifecycle, and verification; it owns no Legion semantics.
interfaceLock.adapters: legion-hook and retained client modules are mechanical lifecycle/protocol bridges only; they invoke installed native Legion and contain no policy, routing, capability, workflow, or receipt implementation.
interfaceLock.identity: Every supported client exposes the same verified runtime, release, catalog, MCP-schema, declarative-asset, and state-compatibility identity tuple.
interfaceLock.qualification: RightKit AX 0.2.0 at 01f52555202da3dffc6b649ca44e803b55238081 owns static, conformance, behavioral, adversarial, and real-client evidence; missing external prerequisites produce a typed blocker, never PASS.

ownershipAmendment.reason: The operator requires maximum safe parallel execution. This packet derives from the frozen 29-path predecessor and applies the approved 30-path amendment while subdividing work into exact disjoint end-to-end implementation lanes.

fileTouchPolicy.legacyPortInputs: Legacy adapter paths in this union may only be retired or reduced to semantic-free compatibility bridges; all other legacy runtime sources remain read-only and deletion remains deferred.
